nodes.label: Global Experiment Configuration
nodes.description: Single source of truth configuration for the tts-tfg improvement experiment replication (Issue #1). Defines seeds (TTs 42, ditto 42, ASR temperature 0), paths, sample subset (10 samples from AISHELL-1/HDTF), and pipeline stages.

nodes.label: Experiment Pipeline Stages
nodes.description: Five pipeline stages: 00_datacheck (read-only health check, min_duration_s>=4.0), 01_asr (DashScope Qwen3-ASR-Flash), 02_tts (provider abstraction supporting faster_qwen3 and dashscope_vc), 03_ditto (TensorRT online mode, raw conditions only: natural_raw + tts_raw), 04_eval (SyncNet evaluation), 05_report (Markdown + figures with Cohen's d).

nodes.label: TTS Provider Abstraction
nodes.description: Abstracted TTS providers: faster_qwen3 (local Qwen3-TTS-0.6B-Base ICL) and dashscope_vc (cloud qwen3-tts-vc-2026-01-22). Supports language=Chinese, retry=1, seed=42.

nodes.label: Ditto TRT Online Configuration
nodes.description: Ditto video generation config: TensorRT online mode (cfg_pkl path, data_root), PyTorch fallback, no loudnorm, raw conditions only (natural_raw + tts_raw), resampling to 16kHz mono 16-bit, output 25fps.

nodes.label: SyncNet Evaluation Configuration
nodes.description: Standard SyncNet evaluation with syncnet_v2.model, batch_size=20, vshift=15. Field mapping: sync_c=Confidence, sync_d=Min dist, av_offset=AV offset.

nodes.label: Report Generation Configuration
nodes.description: Report generation: paired bar charts, scatter plots, Bland-Altman plots. Statistics: alpha=0.05, judge_by_direction (same direction = replication success), report Cohen's d and p-values.

hyperedges.label: Round 1 TTS Provider Comparison Experiment
hyperedges.description: Round 1 experiment comparing six TTS providers (local 0.6B baseline + five cloud APIs) for voice cloning to drive Ditto lip-sync generation. Evaluated with SyncNet metrics via standard 5-stage pipeline.
